name: Copenhagen Roskilde Airport

runway.v: two runways: 11/29, 1,799 m x 31 m, and 03/21, 1,500 m x 31 m

hours.v: aerodrome open 06:00-21:00 UTC in winter and 05:00-20:00 UTC in summer, i.e. 07:00-22:00 local all year

curfew.v: outside opening hours (22:00-07:00 local) all traffic needs prior permission, requested at least 1 hour before closing time
curfew.quote: Outside stated hours PPR for all traffic - submitted not later than 1 hour before closing time.

customs.v: customs clearance and immigration H24 (an earlier edition adds 1 hour prior notice)

ppr.v: PPR for all traffic outside opening hours, at least 1 hour before closing time
ppr.quote: Outside stated hours PPR for all traffic - submitted not later than 1 hour before closing time.

handling.v: all aircraft above 3,000 kg must contact Roskilde Handling before arrival
handling.quote: It is mandatory for all aircraft above 3000 kg to contact

max_aircraft.v: code C aircraft with an outer main gear wheel span of 9 m or more are not permitted; some code C types are excluded
max_aircraft.quote: Code letter C aircraft with Outer Main Gear Wheel Span of 9 metres or more are not permitted at EKRK.

noise.v: jet aircraft may operate only if noise certificated to ICAO Annex 16
noise.quote: Jet aircraft may operate only, if they are noise certificated according to ICAO Annex 16

fuel.v: Avgas 100LL and Jet A-1; self-service H24 for card holders

deicing.v: de-icing H24 with 1 hour prior notice

notes: Read: Danish AIP AD 2 EKRK, latest file found (pages AIRAC AMDT 07/26 of 9 Jul 2026 and 09/26 of 3 Sep 2026). The 1-hour customs prior notice was read in an older edition (AMDT 03/24-08/24) and not confirmed in the current text. Times read as UTC with summer times in brackets (Danish AIP convention). AD 2.20 lists specific code C types not allowed; check the type before booking. Short runways (1.8 km max).
